description:
The image depicts a small transparent plastic bottle containing two roses, placed on a brick wall. The roses are a deep red and a light yellow.

The bottle is positioned in the center of the image, with the red rose on the left and the yellow rose on the right. The background of the image features a brick wall with a row of green leaves behind it. The overall atmosphere of the image is one of simplicity and elegance, with the roses adding a touch of natural beauty to the scene.
